Senses.Explanation: The single 'road upward.' Its locus classicus is Panshan Baoji's sermon: after weighing (即心即佛) ('this mind is Buddha') as still too green and (非心非佛) ('not mind, not Buddha') as merely 'the far limit of pointing,' he says (向上一路)，(千聖不傳)，(學者勞形)，(如猿捉影) ('the road upward — the thousand sages do not transmit it; the student wears himself out, like an ape grabbing at reflections'). (千聖不傳) ('the thousand sages hand it down to no one') is its standing collocation. Later masters keep the phrase in use by riffing on it: Ciming answers (向上一路)，(千聖不然) ('...the thousand sages do not make it so'), Xiangfu (向上一路)，(掘地覓天) ('...digging the ground to look for heaven'), and elsewhere (盤山道向上一路滑) ('the road upward is slippery'). Asked flat out (如何是向上一路) ('what is the road upward?'), masters point rather than define — one raises his robe-collar (師舉衣領示之), one says (汝且向下會取) ('understand it going downward'), others answer with nonsense-tallies (七六八 / 一口針三尺線 / 九九八十一). The record also lines up three masters' one-line characterizations as a set: (盤山道)：『(向上一路滑)。』(南院道)：『(壁立萬仞險)。』(臨濟道)：『(石火電光鈍)。』 ('Panshan says: the road upward is slippery; Nanyuan says: a sheer wall of ten thousand fathoms — perilous; Linji says: flint-spark and lightning-flash — dull', J27nB189; raised as 瑯琊覺's 上堂 in J39nB454, and condensed into an 示眾 of its own in J37nB383: 向上一路滑，壁立千仞險，石火電光遲，諸人各具眼). Masters also throw it at the assembly as a challenge: (還有知得向上一路者麼) ('is there anyone who knows the road upward?', J36nB362; likewise 還有知向上一路者麼, J38nB414).
Senses.Note: Corpus-wide stock phrase, not one master's property. Panshan Baoji is the locus classicus (attested independently in 景德傳燈錄 and 五燈會元); the (千聖不傳) tag and the pointing-not-defining answers recur across the record. RelatedTerm (向上) is a genuine constituent (the 'upward' direction); (千聖不傳) is its standing collocation. Attestation (allowlist grep): (向上一路) 955 hits in 213 texts, joined directly to its tag as (向上一路)(，)(千聖不傳) in 338 hits across 149 texts (千聖不傳 alone: 529 in 192); the test-question (如何是向上一路) 99 hits in 48 texts; the Panshan riff (向上一路滑) 24 in 20. The question is also posed in the waived form (向上一路即不問)，(千聖不傳事若何)？ (J26nB180; similarly J33nB281). Neighboring (向上)-compounds for scale: (向上一著) 279 in 113, (向上事) 1363 in 222.

Occurrences.Kwic: 猶是指蹤之極則。向上一路千聖不傳。學者勞形如猿捉影。

Occurrences.Kwic: 上堂，舉盤山道：向上一路，千聖不傳。慈明道：向上一路，千聖不然。師曰：不傳不然，海口難宣。
Occurrences.AttributionNote: 五燈全書(第34卷-第120卷). Dahui Zonggao explicitly raises Panshan Baoji's statement 向上一路千聖不傳 before contrasting Ciming's 不然 and giving his own comment.

Occurrences.Kwic: 問如何是向上一路。師舉衣領示之。
Occurrences.AttributionNote: Jingde Record of the Transmission of the Lamp (景德傳燈錄): the explicit Dongyan Kexiu heading governs the exchange; asked about the road upward, Dongyan Kexiu raises his robe collar to show it.
